summary: In June 2018, a huge global dust storm blocked its sunlight supply. After thousands of recovery attempts, NASA lost contact and officially ended the mission on February 13, 2019. Having worked for nearly 15 years, Opportunity greatly changed scientists' understanding of Mars and laid a solid foundation for later Mars exploration missions.
details:
Opportunity, also called MER-B, is a solar-powered Mars rover by NASA. It has a twin rover named Spirit. It was launched on 7 July 2003 and landed at Meridiani Planum on 25 January 2004. It is about the size of a golf cart and weighs around 174 kg.

It carries cameras, a microscope and a rock-grinding tool to study rocks and soil. its main job as to find signs of ancient liquid water on Mars. It found small, round hematite stones nicknames "blueberries". This proves the area was noce wet.

It was only planned to work for 90 days, but it explored Mars for nearly 15 years. It travelled 45.16 km, holding the record for the longest distance driven by a rover on another planet. A huge global dust storm cut off its sunlight in June 2018. NASA ended the mission officially on 13 February 2019.
